title: Parse Error: [ext_resource] referenced non-existent resource when two scenes share external resources
body:
### Tested versions

Did not occur in 4.4
Started happening in 4.41

### System information

nixos-unstable

### Issue description

I have two packed scenes, that use a common script and are also included in a third scene.

When I run SceneA, an error is raised because the common script that is being referenced fails to load in SceneB, and then also SceneC fails.
when I run SceneB, an error is raised because the common script fails to load in SceneA and SceneC fails.
These errors prevent me from preloading SceneC.

This smells like a Cyclic Dependency thing, but I fail to see the cycle.
I also fail to understand, why Scene A is even loading when I attempt to run Scene B and vice versa.

### Steps to reproduce

1. [Downlad my git repo](https://gitlab.com/betalars/frame-of-mind/-/tree/setam-demo?ref_type=heads) (sorry, I did not manage to create an MRP)
2. make sure git lfs behaves
3. go to the current setam-demo [sic!] branch 
4. Go to the commit that says debug-me
5. open and run either card.tscn or void_card.tscn
6. check the debugger

~~This issue is unfortunately game-breaking right now. I have tried several workarounds, like making all resources except for the scripts local and so on, but it isn't working for me.~~
Have merged the two different scenes into one and dynamically do the differences via code so that helps, so at least I have a workaround.

Ps.: I suspected it might be something with handwriting.scene, but I eliminated that and it didn't help.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Could not manage to reproduce the issue
